Spinal roots, plexuses and peripheral nerves are modeled from this body's bones, arteries and muscles (the source datasets contain no peripheral nerves). Brain waypoints use the atlas brain structures. Study aid, not a dissection.

Pick a button, then click on any structure (skin, muscle, nerve, brain…) to place that electrode.

Model: homogeneous volume conductor, nerve activating function and strength–duration thresholds per fibre type, skin current density, cortical field strength. Order-of-magnitude estimate for learning — not for real stimulation settings.
